info.name: Square + WhatsApp Order Automation
info.description:
Requests for the Cloudflare Worker. Webhook requests are signed automatically by pre-request scripts.

Safe by default: use synthetic data only. Sending WhatsApp/Square events to a production Worker with a real phone number can message a real customer; keep `customer_phone` on a 555 number or your own test number.

See docs/troubleshooting.md for failure codes.
